errors.name: UnknownFeed
errors.description: The generator does not serve the requested feed.

errors.name: UnsupportedFeedScope
errors.description: The generator does not support the requested scope.

errors.name: InvalidCursor
errors.description: The cursor is malformed or expired.

feed.description: AT-URI of the social.coves.feed.generator record being requested

scope.description: Which feed surface the request is for: all communities, the viewer's home feed, or one community

community.description: DID of the community for scope=community

timeframe.description: Timeframe for feeds ranked by top score

main.description: Get an ordered page of post URIs from a feed generator. Served by the generator's service and called by the AppView, which hydrates the posts.

reqId.description: Request ID assigned by the generator. The AppView returns it on the hydrated response, and clients send it back with interactions.

output.description: A page of post URIs in the generator's order
